verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes machine-readable API reference material: a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec for the Management API (probe-verified HTTP 200) and per-language reference corpora (js, python, cli, api, and others) via llms.txt. Auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs and type generation are also documented. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference explorer or runnable, try-it-in-browser examples, which are the core of this story. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable or executable examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an interactive docs experience.
